meta.name: troy_horse
meta.prompt: The Trojan horse in Troy, right before the soldiers emerge.

character.label: Troy on the eve of the siege

programs.brief: An unmistakable colossal wooden Trojan horse stands on four grounded legs in Troy's civic square, with rough timber joinery, a long neck and head, a tail, and a silhouette that dominates the surrounding city. Make it hollow and enterable: a concealed belly chamber contains Greek soldiers waiting in darkness behind a closed, camouflaged hatch, with no soldier emerged yet; publish a grounded door anchor for the hidden entrance.

tokens.scene: The Trojan horse stands inside Troy immediately before the hidden soldiers emerge.
